description: §86a StGB terms by language, read by the safety checks and by the upload check of the knowledge library
usage: Loaded by load_bilingual_86a_terms() in schemas/engine/stage_orchestrator.py and matched there, fuzzy from six letters on. my_app/services/safety_gate.py runs the lists of every language over what a media model receives, as written and in English, and over a text a language model wrote; at every level but research. my_app/services/upload_gate.py runs the lists of the detected language and English over the text layer of a PDF uploaded to the knowledge library, at every level.
rationale: At the safety checks a hit decides nothing alone: the list knows neither the context of a word nor the symbols it lacks. The safety classifier answers the level's question in any case; after a hit it also answers the symbol question.

stage1_critical_86a.description: §86a StGB terms (German law), by language: the safety checks read every language, the upload check of the knowledge library the detected language and English
stage1_critical_86a.legal_reference: §86a StGB (Germany) - Use of symbols of unconstitutional and terrorist organizations

note: At the upload check of the knowledge library a hit alone rejects the document; no classifier is asked there.
